What we treat

Hair and skin treatments in Jaipur

Our flagship clinic has the widest team and our operation theatre for hair transplant surgery.

Hair transplant in Jaipur

Our doctors perform FUE and DHI hair transplants in the clinic's operation theatre, as well as beard and eyebrow transplants, after a trichoscopy check of your donor area.

PRP and GFC for hair fall

For thinning hair that is still growing, PRP and GFC injections use growth factors from your own blood. A hair loss consultation first finds the cause of your hair fall.

Skin and laser treatments

Our skin specialists treat acne and scars, pigmentation, dark circles and signs of ageing, and offer HydraFacial, Botox and laser hair removal.

White hair removal

White, grey and blonde hairs cannot be treated with laser. We remove them one by one with doctor-led electrolysis.

Permanent makeup and body sculpting

Microblading, lip blush and permanent eyeliner with our PMU artist, and non-surgical body sculpting for stubborn fat.

Visiting specialists

Consultations for plastic and aesthetic surgery, rhinoplasty and ENT and internal medicine with our visiting consultants.

First visit

Your first visit to Kezza Jaipur

01

Book a slot

Call +91 92845 17427 or WhatsApp the clinic with your concern and a preferred time. The team confirms which doctor you will see.

02

Bring your history

Bring previous prescriptions, reports and a list of the medicines you take. For a hair assessment, come with clean, dry hair without oil or styling products.

03

Consultation and examination

The doctor listens to your concerns and examines your scalp or skin, using trichoscopy for hair loss.

04

A clear plan

You receive a treatment plan with the number of sessions or grafts and an estimate, so you can decide in your own time.

FAQs

Visiting our Jaipur clinic

What are the timings of Kezza Clinic Jaipur?
The Jaipur clinic is open from 9 AM to 8 PM, all 7 days a week, including Sundays. Booking ahead by phone or WhatsApp makes sure the right doctor is available when you arrive.
Where is Kezza Clinic in Jaipur?
A-7, 1st Floor, Hanuman Nagar, Sirsi Road, Khatipura, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302012. The clinic is on the first floor of A-7, Hanuman Nagar, on the main Sirsi Road in Khatipura, convenient from Vaishali Nagar, Jhotwara and the rest of West Jaipur. Use Google Maps directions to reach the door.
Which doctors see patients at the Jaipur clinic?
Dr. Ankit Bhalothia, Dr. Amrita Mukhija, Dr. Neelam Choudhary, Dr. Nakul Somani, Dr. Mandhata Sharma, Dr. Youvraj Singh, Krishna Choudhary. See their qualifications and experience on our doctors page.
How do I book an appointment at the Jaipur clinic?
Call +91 92845 17427 or +91 70735 65197, message us on WhatsApp, or use the form on our contact page. Share your concern and a preferred time, and the team will confirm your slot.
Can I get a hair transplant at the Jaipur clinic?
Yes. The Jaipur clinic offers hair transplant consultations and procedures. Your doctor first checks your donor area and hair-loss stage, then explains the plan. Read about hair transplant at Kezza.
Is hair transplant surgery done at the Jaipur clinic?
Yes. The Jaipur clinic has an operation theatre for hair transplant surgery, where our doctors perform FUE, DHI, beard and eyebrow transplants. Read about FUE and DHI.
Which visiting specialists see patients in Jaipur?
Dr. Nakul Somani (aesthetic and reconstructive plastic surgeon), Dr. Mandhata Sharma (ENT, rhinoplasty and head and neck surgeon) and Dr. Youvraj Singh (consultant physician) visit our Jaipur clinic. Call ahead to check their consultation days.
Is laser hair removal available at the Jaipur clinic?
Yes. Laser hair removal for the face and body is available in Jaipur, with settings chosen for your skin type. See laser hair removal for sessions, preparation and aftercare.
